title: Body & State Check
purpose: Map what your body and surroundings are dealing with before deciding what a feeling means.

title: Body Check
purpose: Map what your body is doing before deciding what it means.

title: Mixed Feelings
purpose: Name more than one feeling without forcing them into agreement.

title: Emotion Timeline
purpose: Trace how feelings changed over an event, without assuming one is the “real” one.

title: Feelings Check-In
purpose: Build a clearer map of one feeling, its urge, what matters and what—if anything—you want to do.

title: Brain Dump
purpose: Empty your head, separate thoughts by what they need, and choose only the next useful attention.

title: Thought Map
purpose: Map the tangle, then reality-check it, prepare a conversation, compare options, or build a clear next thread.

title: Reality Map
purpose: Sort the moment into camera, narrator, feeling and missing footage, then test the story and choose a response without perfect certainty.

title: CBT Journal
purpose: Investigate a difficult thought as a hypothesis: separate facts, story, feeling, action and one fair next test.

title: Assumption Finder
purpose: Find the hidden “must”, “always”, or “this means” inside a thought.

title: Rumination Check
purpose: Notice when another round of thinking is helping, or when a different move may help more.

title: Sensory Reset
purpose: Notice the sensory mismatch, change one variable, and learn what helps your system right now.

title: Grounding
purpose: Re-establish where you are, what is happening now, and what your senses can confirm.

title: Sensory Profile
purpose: Notice preferences across settings; seeking, avoiding and “depends” can all be true.

title: Sensory Recipe
purpose: Make a small, situation-specific sensory plan: what to try first, what to use if that is unavailable, and what to notice next.

title: Social Battery
purpose: See what a social interaction gave you, cost you, and what conditions would make it easier next time.

title: Load Balancer
purpose: See demands as a stack, find what can move, and reduce pressure through one realistic leverage point.

title: Transition Planner
purpose: Make switching activities more visible and less abrupt.

title: Start Barrier
purpose: Find the barrier before demanding more willpower.

title: Motivation Map
purpose: Several motives can coexist—including wanting something and fearing it.

title: Friction Finder
purpose: Look for what makes a wanted action harder than it needs to be.

title: Small Step
purpose: Find the smallest action that meaningfully changes your position.

title: If–Then Plan
purpose: Pair a likely cue with a response you choose in advance.

title: Decision Map
purpose: Compare options across values, costs, uncertainty and effects on others.

title: Future Perspectives
purpose: Consider several time horizons without assuming future-you knows best.

title: Pre-Mortem
purpose: Imagine an option went badly and ask what conditions may have contributed.

title: Decision Review
purpose: Choose what new information would genuinely justify revisiting a choice.

title: Pattern Map
purpose: Map context, state, interpretation, urge and consequence without assigning a diagnosis.

title: Function Finder
purpose: Ask what a response may accomplish before trying to change it.

title: Pattern Experiment
purpose: Change one manageable variable, observe what happens, and update the explanation.

title: Conversation Map
purpose: Separate what was said, intended and heard in a misunderstanding.

title: Needs Clarifier
purpose: Name the request underneath a difficult interaction.

title: Boundary Builder
purpose: Distinguish a preference, request, boundary and attempt to control another person.

title: Conflict Map
purpose: Separate facts, interpretations, interests, needs, values, power and possible options.

title: Repair Plan
purpose: Consider impact, responsibility and change without forcing reconciliation.

title: Values Discovery
purpose: Notice values in admiration, envy, anger, grief, pride, sacrifice, regret or joy.

title: Identity Map
purpose: Explore identities and roles as central, chosen, inherited, performed or changing.

title: Possible Selves
purpose: Imagine who you could become without needing to discover one fixed “true self.”

title: Personal Rules
purpose: Collect rules you have learnt and decide whether they still fit.

title: Two Truths
purpose: Hold apparently conflicting wants without demanding that one disappear.

title: Life Areas
purpose: Notice where life feels tended, neglected or overloaded—without producing a score.

title: Appreciation
purpose: Slow down around one good detail rather than forcing a list.

title: Difficult Day
purpose: Review demands, supports and learning without asking what is wrong with you.

title: Weekly Review
purpose: Gather patterns, experiments, questions and changes you noticed this week.

title: Claim Checker
purpose: Break a claim into what it says, what evidence it needs and what remains unknown.

title: Evidence Guide
purpose: Compare what different study designs can and cannot tell you.

title: Argument Map
purpose: Lay out premises, evidence, inference, conclusion and counterargument.

title: Stim Space
purpose: Explore movement, touch, sound and visual stimulation in the ND play space.

title: Worry Sort
purpose: Separate a practical problem you can act on from a possibility that may need uncertainty-tolerance or support.

title: Masking Map
purpose: Map what you adapt, what it protects, what it costs, and where a safer 10% reduction might be possible.

title: Environment Design
purpose: Change cues, access and friction around an action instead of relying only on willpower.

title: Reward Design
purpose: Pair a demanding action with a kind, realistic source of interest, comfort or celebration.

title: Progress Evidence
purpose: Track attempts, learning and recovery—not just finished outcomes.

title: Conflict Pattern
purpose: Look for a recurring sequence between people without deciding that one person is the whole problem.

title: Positive Memory
purpose: Spend a moment with a specific memory if that feels welcome; you do not need to feel positive.

title: Alternative Explanations
purpose: Hold two or more explanations side by side and ask what each would predict.

title: Confidence Check
purpose: Record how sure you feel, what would change your mind, and revisit later without needing perfect certainty.

title: Anger Pause
purpose: Build a safe pause-and-return plan before sending, shouting or confronting.

title: Fair Load
purpose: Name an unequal demand and ask for a concrete redistribution.

title: Shame Check
purpose: Separate an event from a global judgement about your worth.

title: Guilt Check
purpose: Distinguish a specific responsibility from hindsight and impossible control.

title: Jealousy Plan
purpose: Turn a feared loss or comparison into an honest need and a respectful choice.

title: Rejection Reset
purpose: Separate hurt, useful feedback and conclusions you cannot yet know.

title: Grief Plan
purpose: Prepare choices for a difficult date without imposing a timeline for grief.

title: Low Mood Plan
purpose: Choose a small care, connection or interest activity without waiting for motivation.

title: Panic Plan
purpose: Prepare a brief response for familiar episodes and identify when to seek medical help.

title: Disappointment Reset
purpose: Acknowledge a lost outcome and decide what can still matter.

title: Connection Plan
purpose: Match a social step to the kind of connection and energy you have.

title: Good Enough
purpose: Set a task-specific stopping rule before another round of checking.

title: Shutdown Card
purpose: Write a message you can show or copy when spoken communication is difficult.

title: Meltdown Plan
purpose: Plan environmental changes and support before overload peaks.

title: Burnout Reset
purpose: Turn a sustained drop in capacity into concrete temporary adjustments.

title: Time Reality
purpose: Include preparation, travel and transitions in one realistic time estimate.

title: Memory Offload
purpose: Create one reliable place to capture and resume a multi-step task.

title: Impulse Pause
purpose: Create a short delay for a nonurgent purchase, post or commitment.

title: Change Preview
purpose: Restore enough predictability when a plan changes.

title: Processing Request
purpose: Turn a processing barrier into a specific communication request.

title: Reading Access
purpose: Match the format of a task to the part that is causing difficulty.

title: Coordination Plan
purpose: Change equipment, positioning or sequence instead of simply trying harder.

title: Appointment Brief
purpose: Make the main concern, daily impact and access needs easier to communicate.

title: Care Balance
purpose: Separate essential care from the expectation that you must do every part alone.

title: Emotion Compass
purpose: Move from energy and pleasantness toward a feeling word that fits.

title: Regulation Picker
purpose: Choose what your system is doing and see a few matching ways to adjust the moment.

title: Breathing Pacer
purpose: Follow a gentle expanding shape. Choose a comfortable pace and skip breath holds.

title: Muscle Release
purpose: Move through body regions and try a small soften-and-release pause.

title: Infinite Pattern
purpose: Tap to build a repeating, mirrored pattern and change its pace and colour.

title: Control Zones
purpose: Place example worries into what you can act on, influence or release for now.

title: Perspective Wheel
purpose: Turn among your view, another view, a neutral observer and your future self.

title: Trigger Chain
purpose: Connect event, body, thought, feeling, urge, action and consequence.

title: Pattern Loop
purpose: See how a short-term relief loop can make the same response more likely next time.

title: Cost–Benefit
purpose: Compare immediate effects with effects that arrive later.

title: Values Balance
purpose: Hold two real competing goods in view and adjust their importance.

title: Friction Finder
purpose: Select and size barriers so a stuck task becomes easier to understand.

title: Task Shrinker
purpose: Step down from a large task toward one small, visible action.

title: Priority Matrix
purpose: Write your own tasks, then drag them between Do, Plan, Delegate and Delete.

title: Energy Budget
purpose: Allocate a limited number of energy tokens across the day.

title: Thought Defusion
purpose: Change the distance, size and volume of a sample thought.

title: Urge Surfing
purpose: Follow an animated wave and watch an urge move without needing to act on it.

title: Safety Scale
purpose: Use more than a safe-or-dangerous binary to mark how a situation feels.

title: Self-Compassion
purpose: Compare what you might say to yourself, a friend or a stranger.

title: Savouring Timer
purpose: Choose a pleasant moment and give it 30, 60 or 90 seconds of attention.

title: Choice Pause
purpose: Take a brief stop–body–urge–consequence–choose sequence before acting.

title: Social Scripts
purpose: Build a message for an ambiguous social moment, then edit or copy it in your own voice.
